inputs.name: backBtnAriaLabel
inputs.description: aria-label and title value for the back button

inputs.name: detailsAreaTitleHeading
inputs.description:
Heading level for the title in the Details Area
Default value is 2
Acceptable values: number 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6

inputs.name: detailsAreaTitleHeadingSize
inputs.description:
Heading level display size for the title in the Details Area (controls the font size)
Default value is 5
Acceptable values: number 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6

methods.name: clearViewStack
methods.description: Clear all stacked views and return to the main template.

methods.name: popView
methods.description:
Pop the top view from the stack, returning to the previous view.
If no stacked views exist, this method does nothing.

methods.name: pushView
methods.description:
Push a secondary view onto the stack.
Use this to navigate to a drill-down view within a settings section.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: The title to display in the header
